scenarios.title: Synthetic segmentation review
scenarios.evidence: Identify the cleartext workstation-to-database path and propose a boundary control.

scenarios.title: Least-privilege review
scenarios.evidence: Show that Alice can read reports but cannot approve them.
scenarios.verification: authorize() must enforce the synthetic role permissions.

scenarios.title: Endpoint telemetry classification
scenarios.evidence: Classify the synthetic PowerShell process event without executing it.

scenarios.title: Synthetic incident investigation
scenarios.evidence: Correlate repeated authentication failures with the synthetic privilege change.
scenarios.verification: detect_blue_team() must produce AUTH-BRUTE-001 and PRIV-ESC-001.

scenarios.title: Contained remediation
scenarios.evidence: Demonstrate the vulnerable local behavior, then verify the hardened regression tests.

scenarios.title: Security gate review
scenarios.evidence: Inspect repository CI security gates and record the controls they enforce.
scenarios.verification: CI workflow and security lab tests must remain valid.

scenarios.title: Workload boundary review
scenarios.evidence: Review Kubernetes RBAC, workload identity and network-policy controls in the showcase repository.
scenarios.verification: Use repository CI evidence; no external cluster is required.

scenarios.title: Attack-to-remediation chain
scenarios.evidence: Connect vulnerability, detection, containment, remediation and verification evidence.
scenarios.verification: capstone_chain() must return true for every stage.
